paragraphs: Creditspring’s mission to give members a reliable financial safety net mirrors my recent work building an agentic tool that delivers real‑time insights to a subscription‑based product start‑up, where I proposed and prototyped a FastMCP solution in Python using FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, showcased in a live stakeholder demo.

I built scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker, ensuring seamless integration and rapid iteration for the client’s data‑driven product.
Could we schedule a brief call so I can walk you through how these experiences translate into measurable improvements for Creditspring’s subscription products?
